name: Re;quartz Birthday Stories
source: A set of five short birthday stories for the cast of Re;quartz, released free on the circle's website through 2015, one on each character's birthday. Leito, Motoi, Saiki, Yuzuki and Nao each get a standalone episode.
translation: 《Re;quartz》登场角色生日短篇故事五篇合集，于2015年间每逢各角色生日当天在社团官网免费公开。礼人、基、才纪、柚月与直五人各自拥有一篇独立短篇剧情。
